sentences.text:
Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The Application is disposed of.

Criminal Appeal under Section 415 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 has been filed to call and examine the record of Court of learned ASJ for setting aside the impugned Judgment dated 13.08.2025 and Order on Sentence dated 20.08.2025 in FIR No. 0297/2016 registered under Sections 376(2)(n)/417/506 IPC at P.S. Harsh Vihar.
4. On advance Notice, learned APP has appeared and accepted the notice on behalf of the Respondent/State.
5. Notice be issued to the Prosecutrix through IO, returnable on 17.12.2025.
6. E Trial Court Record be summoned for the next date of hearing.
